model.name: GRIDIRON IQ rolling-form logistic regression
model.performanceNote: Compare this model against the holdout baseline before treating probabilities as reliable. Predictions are exploratory estimates, not betting advice.
model.validationMethod: Chronological season holdout; each game uses only team games played before that matchup.

predictions.projectedScoreMethod: Average of each team's trailing points scored and opponent points allowed; descriptive estimate, not a guaranteed result.
predictions.dataNote: Probabilities are generated by a logistic-regression model trained on historical NFL play-by-play, using pregame rolling team form. No sportsbook odds or AI-generated stats are used.

limitations: Injuries and inactive lists are not included unless present in the underlying play-by-play inputs.
Early-season predictions rely on limited current-season form and neutral defaults where necessary.
Projected scores are simple recent scoring/allowance estimates, not a separate trained score model.
